title: DeepSlides: Design First, Code Later (explicit design plan before PPTX code)
pipeline_shape: Explicit design plan (background/layout/content layers) BEFORE code emission; VLM eval loop; SFT + multi-agent RL for 0.6B SlideQwen.
key_numbers: 0.6B SlideQwen reaches 86% success
reusable_for_us: Evidence that the composition descriptor is worth making STRUCTURED (a plan artifact) rather than a sentence.

title: LASEV: Large-scale Automated STEM Explainer Video generation (Baidu)
pipeline_shape: Orchestrator + Solution/Illustration/Narration agents emit an Executable Video Script S=(P,N,A) (content, narration segments, alignment rules) that is DETERMINISTICALLY compiled to Manim + TTS.
representation: Executable Video Script (content, narration segments, alignment rules)
verification: Three critics — semantic (LLM rubric vs syllabus), tool (compile), rule (format/keyword) — loop until pass; 0–3 expert rubric on 1,003 videos
key_numbers: >1M videos/day; $0.056 per 2-min video; 96.4% production success over 20M videos; 92–96% publishable (≥2 of 3 teachers)
reusable_for_us: Validates the IR + deterministic-compile bet at scale; sync by step-to-time mapping plus computed self.wait(T) = narration end − animation end; duration-by-symbolic-density pacing rule; the 0/1/2/3 release rubric.
notes: No geometric layout probe reported.

title: LLM2Manim: human-in-the-loop Manim generation with a symbol ledger; 100-student A/B
pipeline_shape: Constrained prompt templates; symbol ledger for cross-scene consistency; selective regeneration of failing sections; Mayer segmentation/signaling.
key_numbers: 100-student A/B: 83% vs 78% post-test, d=0.67
reusable_for_us: Symbol ledger ≈ our narrative anchor + id continuity, with learning-outcome evidence; the study design is a template for our own learner test.

title: OmniDiagram: unified diagram-code generation with generative visual-interrogation reward (VIVA)
pipeline_shape: RL where the reward asks targeted visual questions of the render and checks them.
verification: visual question answering over the render
key_numbers: 196k instances
reusable_for_us: Turn each drawing's description into yes/no questions for a resemblance check — same idea as SimuScene's verification questions.

title: OmniManim / See Before You Code: keyframe-layout-first Manim generation with CV diagnostics
pipeline_shape: Vision agent predicts sparse keyframe bboxes (heatmap → 16-step coordinate denoising, interpolation-aware); code agent maps bboxes to Manim coords; post-render CV diagnostics; localized repair routed to the responsible agent.
representation: keyframe bounding boxes + relations → Manim code
verification: Pixel-level overlap (HSV masks, IoU≥0.20, text-line crossing), boundary overflow, relation violations, flicker; repair ACCEPTED only if L_coll≤0.02, L_rel≤0.15, L_bound≤0.01; max one round
key_numbers: vs Code2Video-GPT5.4: overlap 0.763 vs 0.598, layout 0.931 vs 0.742, Render@1 0.907
datasets_released: ManimLayout-1K (22.6k keyframes with GT bboxes), EduRequire-500
reusable_for_us: Closest published twin of our probe+accept-if-better loop, with NUMERIC thresholds; their pixel-level overlap catches text-over-image, which our mobject probe skips; ManimLayout-1K is a free test bed for zone heuristics.
notes: Only other system with explicit numeric acceptance thresholds.

title: SimuScene: text → simulation code → MP4, verified by per-scenario VLM questions
pipeline_shape: LLM writes Python producing an MP4; verification = per-scenario yes/no 'verification questions' answered by a VLM majority vote; RL with binary video reward.
key_numbers: 7,659 scenarios (334 human-verified test); 86.9% human agreement; best model 21.5% Avg@8
reusable_for_us: Give each `simulation` element 2–3 yes/no motion questions and let the vision stage answer them — a semantic complement to sim_gen.verify()'s geometric checks.

title: Code2Video: A Code-centric Paradigm for Educational Video Generation (MMMC benchmark, TeachQuiz)
pipeline_shape: Planner (outline → per-section storyboard: title + lecture lines + paired animations) → Coder with ScopeRefine (line±1 → block → section) → VLM Critic over a 6×6 visual-anchor grid.
representation: storyboard JSON + anchor-grid occupancy table → Manim code
verification: VLM flags overlap-in-cell / occlusion / unused regions; TeachQuiz (VLM unlearn-then-relearn quiz); AES 5×20 pts
key_numbers: Element Layout 0.59→0.91 vs TEA; Visual Relevance 0.79→0.91; ~40% over direct codegen
reusable_for_us: Scope-escalating repair (line → block → section) is a cheaper repair-brief policy than whole-scene rewrite; TeachQuiz is a no-human learning-outcome proxy.
notes: No narration audio; acceptance rule not formalised (accepts last refinement).

title: Paper2Video / PaperTalker: automatic presentation video from scientific papers
pipeline_shape: LLM writes Beamer; for bad slides enumerate variants (figure scale × font size) → render each → VLM picks best; cursor grounding via UI-TARS + WhisperX word timestamps; F5-TTS + talking head.
verification: Meta Similarity, PresentArena, PresentQuiz, IP Memory
reusable_for_us: Enumerate-then-judge beats asking an LLM to nudge numbers — a candidate replacement for LLM repair of scale/font violations; WhisperX word timestamps for cursor sync is the same plumbing bookmarks need.

title: TheoremExplainAgent: Towards Multimodal Explanations for LLM Theorem Understanding (+ TheoremExplainBench)
authors: Ku, Chong et al. — TIGER-AI-Lab, U. Waterloo
pipeline_shape: Planner LLM writes outline/storyboard/technical plan as prose; coder LLM writes whole-scene Manim with doc-RAG and render-error retry; manim-voiceover TTS.
verification: Render success + VLM-judged 5 dimensions (Accuracy&Depth, Visual Relevance, Logical Flow, Element Layout, Visual Consistency)
key_numbers: o3-mini 93.8% success, 0.77 overall; Spearman vs 12 humans: Visual Relevance 0.72, Element Layout 0.42, Accuracy&Depth 0.14, Logical Flow 0.16
reusable_for_us: TEB as an external regression benchmark; its human-correlation table says a VLM judge is usable for visual relevance, weak for layout, noise for pedagogy.
notes: Authors note most videos have minor layout issues — the gap our probe fills.

title: GeoSVG-RL: layout-constrained text-to-SVG diagrams with geometry-aware reward
pipeline_shape: RL reward includes geometric layout constraints.
reusable_for_us: Nearest to our zone contract for drawn objects.

title: ManiBench: syntactic hallucination and visual-logic drift in LLM-written Manim
pipeline_shape: Benchmark only: executability, API version-conflict rate, alignment, coverage tiers.
key_numbers: 12 pilot problems, growing to 150–200
reusable_for_us: The version-conflict tier is exactly what manim_context's installed-package introspection defends against — a ready-made test.

title: ManimAgent: self-evolving dual-channel memory for Manim code generation
pipeline_shape: Coder + VLM keyframe critic; episodic memory of validated successes (soft exemplars) and validated failures (hard pitfalls) grown from the agent's own task stream.
verification: VLM keyframe critic; blind human Pass@1
key_numbers: Pass@1 rises and reflection rounds fall as memory grows (see paper for curves)
reusable_for_us: Mine accepted repairs and rejected candidates from .mp4.json sidecars into a verified-only few-shot store for the repair brief.

title: ManimTrainer / ManimAgent-RITL: renderer-in-the-loop SFT+GRPO for small models (ManimBench)
authors: Silva, Lotfi et al. — Nottingham Trent U.
pipeline_shape: SFT + GRPO on 17 sub-30B open models with renderer-in-the-loop and Manim-doc-augmented retries.
verification: Render success + visual similarity on ManimBench (417 description/code pairs)
key_numbers: Qwen3-Coder-30B: 94% render success, 85.7% visual similarity
reusable_for_us: Evidence a small local model + doc-RAG can own the one-function sim_gen/asset_gen tier cheaply.

title: MINARD / FigTalk: narrated figure walkthroughs grounded to figure regions
pipeline_shape: Figure + paper → narration grounded sequentially to figure regions.
reusable_for_us: The only work measuring narration↔visual-region alignment explicitly — a metric template for bookmark-hit accuracy.

title: Render-in-the-Loop SVG generation (step-wise render + verify)
pipeline_shape: Renders partial code into a cumulative canvas; render-and-verify drops degenerate primitives.
reusable_for_us: Degenerate-primitive check mirrors asset_gen's _is_visible.

title: ResearchStudio-Reel: paper → poster / video-deck / blog with measured-fill loop
pipeline_shape: Shared extractor → artifact builders with a measured-fill loop and artifact-specific release checks.
key_numbers: 3.56 vs 3.03 (VLM aesthetics vs human posters)
reusable_for_us: Measured-fill loop = our enlarge-to-fill made iterative against a fill metric.

title: Vision-Guided Iterative Refinement (VLM critic-in-the-loop, ≤3 cycles)
pipeline_shape: Fully automated VLM critic loop; LoRA distils the gain.
key_numbers: +17.8% with ≤3 cycles; LoRA distils ~25% of the gain
reusable_for_us: Confirms diminishing returns after 2–3 rounds — consistent with OVERLAP_REPAIR_ROUNDS=2.
notes: Accepts last round; no acceptance gate.

title: Paper2Poster / PosterAgent
pipeline_shape: Parser → hierarchical planner (binary-tree layout) → visual-in-the-loop painter/commenter.
key_numbers: $0.005 per poster
reusable_for_us: Binary-tree layout planning is a whole-frame composition primitive we lack.
notes: Follow-ups: PosterForest 2508.21720, APEX 2601.04794, Any2Poster 2606.02915

title: DeTikZify (+ v2): MCTS over compile-and-render with perceptual reward for TikZ
pipeline_shape: MCTS over candidate programs, each compiled and rendered, scored by perceptual similarity.
reusable_for_us: MCTS/rollout-with-render is the principled version of 'candidate must render and score better'.

title: 1D-Bench: iterative UI codegen with visual feedback
pipeline_shape: Iterative code generation with visual feedback rounds.
key_numbers: feedback rounds help significantly
reusable_for_us: Another diminishing-returns data point.

title: PaperBanana: retrieve → plan → render (image model) → self-critique for paper figures
pipeline_shape: Raster image-model rendering with critique loop.
reusable_for_us: Low — raster, not code.

title: PDE-grounded intent verification of generated multiphysics code
pipeline_shape: Checks that generated code solves the intended PDE, not just that it runs.
reusable_for_us: 'Runs but solves the wrong physics' = verify intent, not execution — same spirit as our contract-vs-security split.

title: PRISM: programmatic spatial-temporal reasoning benchmark (Manim-style animation code)
pipeline_shape: Benchmark: pixel-wise + programmatic checks on generated animation code.
key_numbers: LLMs weak at time-dependent layout
reusable_for_us: Test set for mid-animation layout behaviour once the probe samples mid-transition.

title: RefineSVG: Diff-Map residual fed back ReAct-style
pipeline_shape: Pixel-diff residual between target and render drives edits.
reusable_for_us: Residual-driven brief is a tighter repair signal than a prose critique.

title: Animo (successor of generative-manim) — product
pipeline_shape: Thin LLM→Manim wrapper.
reusable_for_us: Competitive reference only; no layout/repair machinery disclosed.

title: ChartMaster (and MM-ReCoder 2604.01600): chart-code generation with visual feedback / RL
pipeline_shape: Chart code with render-based feedback.
reusable_for_us: Relevant to asset_gen's draw(ax) tier.

title: EduVisAgent / EduVisBench: pedagogical-planning multi-agent for static visualisations
pipeline_shape: Multi-agent planning for pedagogical visualisations.
reusable_for_us: Rubric dimensions for pedagogical visuals.

title: Manimator: markdown scene description → DeepSeek-V3 → Manim
pipeline_shape: Single-pass codegen, no repair loop.
key_numbers: 0.845 on TEB
reusable_for_us: Baseline only.

title: MCP-SIM: plan–act–reflect–revise multi-agent physics simulation with persistent memory
pipeline_shape: Multi-agent simulation code with error diagnosis and memory.
key_numbers: 12-task physics bench, 100% success
reusable_for_us: Low — numeric not visual.

title: PPTAgent + PPTEval
pipeline_shape: Edit-action generation over reference decks; PPTEval LLM-judge (content/design/coherence).

title: RLRF: Rendering-aware RL for SVG
pipeline_shape: RL with render-based rewards.

title: Sketch2Code / Design2Code: screenshot self-revision for UI code
pipeline_shape: VLM sees rendered screenshot and revises code; interactive agent with simulated user.

title: SlideCoder: layout-aware RAG, image → editable slides
pipeline_shape: Layout-aware retrieval then code.
reusable_for_us: Retrieval of layout exemplars by visual kind.

title: ALGOGEN: tracker traces → deterministic renderer with a Rendering Style Language
pipeline_shape: LLM emits trackers → VTA-JSON traces → deterministic renderer (Manim/TikZ/Three.js); layout kind is an LLM-selectable enum (force_directed | hierarchical | circular | grid | matrix | horizontal_array).
key_numbers: 99.8% vs 82.5% success on 200 LeetCode tasks
reusable_for_us: The layout-kind enum is the pattern for P11's 'other layout kinds' (radial/force/flow) on top of connects.
notes: MIT release promised.

title: SGA: Symbolic Geometric Agent — plug-and-play geometric verification for educational video synthesis (MVQS)
pipeline_shape: Instruments construct() statement-by-statement, extracts a symbolic scene graph (AABB, class, source line), computes pairwise overlap + minimum separation vector, samples 11 frames per animation but IGNORES transient mid-trajectory overlaps, patches only persistent resting-frame violations with ±5-line localized LLM edits.
representation: symbolic scene graph from instrumented code
key_numbers: +16.1% relative MVQS on Code2Video+GPT-5.1 (peak 73.11); gains on 7/8 backbone–pipeline combos
reusable_for_us: Closest sibling of our probe; the resting-vs-transient distinction is the design decision our per-play probe lacks; MVQS is a candidate scalar layout score.

title: Feynman: knowledge-infused agent writes Penrose programs; solver places (Diagramma benchmark)
pipeline_shape: LLM names objects and relations in Penrose Substance/Style; Penrose optimises layout.
key_numbers: 100k diagram–caption pairs (Diagramma)
reusable_for_us: The exact LLM+solver division of labour the decomposition asks for: model names relations, solver places.

title: VFIG: rubric VLM judges over presence / layout / connectivity / details
pipeline_shape: Four-axis rubric judging of generated figures.
reusable_for_us: The four-axis rubric is a sound judge prompt for drawing() outputs (resemblance).

title: DiagramEval: diagram ≙ graph; node-alignment + path-alignment metrics on SVG
pipeline_shape: Evaluate a generated diagram as a graph of text nodes and directed edges.
reusable_for_us: A connects-graph-vs-rendered-graph checker is exactly this.

title: Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK) — layered, force, radial, box/flow algorithms; Mermaid @mermaid-js/layout-elk
pipeline_shape: Deterministic graph layout engine; LLMs overwhelmingly emit Mermaid which can route through ELK.
reusable_for_us: Drop-in for the radial/force/flow layout kinds once connects graphs need more than BFS layering.
notes: Graphviz dot, d3-force, yFiles are the other production options; Cassowary/Kiwi for GUI constraints.

title: ReLayout: relation-CoT layout generation (region / salient / margin relations)
pipeline_shape: MLLM emits explicit relations (region, salient, margin) and decomposes layout recursively into sub-layouts; prototype-rebalance sampler.
reusable_for_us: Closest published analogue to zones+connects+inside: relations as first-class fields the model emits, not coordinates.

title: Visual Moment Equilibrium: balance as moment equilibrium of a perceptual force field
pipeline_shape: Computational balance index from element weights and positions.
verification: psychophysical transform; Measured-Balance index; Shape Sparsity Ratio
reusable_for_us: A ~30-line post-render scorer on element bboxes + areas that directly targets 'dead space' and top-heavy frames.

title: Bluefish: relational diagramming (Align, Distribute, Arrow, Background) over a compound scenegraph
pipeline_shape: Local constraint propagation over relations, no global optimisation.
reusable_for_us: Relation vocabulary (Align/Distribute) is the row/column primitive we lack.
notes: No 2025–26 follow-up found.

title: Penrose (+ Minkowski Penalties, SIGGRAPH 2024): constraint-based diagram layout by gradient optimisation
authors: Ye, Ni, Crane, Sunshine — CMU; Minarčík, Estep, Ni, Crane
pipeline_shape: Substance/Style/Domain DSLs; constraints as non-negative penalties; differentiable SDF/Minkowski penalties for containment, tangency, padding between arbitrary shapes.
reusable_for_us: Minkowski penalties are the principled replacement for AABB inside/padding checks; Penrose's objective list (repel, contain, non-overlap) is a spec for a post-hoc scorer.
notes: Also Bloom (PLATEAU 2025) and 'Synthesizing Visual Specifications' (PLATEAU 2026).

title: AesEval-Bench: 4 dims / 12 indicators, judgment + region selection + localisation
authors: Sun, Bian et al. — Microsoft Research
pipeline_shape: Benchmark for aesthetic judgement by VLMs.
key_numbers: VLMs show 'clear gaps'
reusable_for_us: Calibration data for a visual judge.

title: LaySPA: RL over a textual spatial environment with geometric + relational + aesthetic rewards
pipeline_shape: GRPO-style RL; reward = geometric validity + relational coherence + aesthetic consistency.
representation: canvas geometry + inter-element relations as text
reusable_for_us: Their reward decomposition is a ready-made scoring rubric for a deterministic layout.

title: sPyTial / CnD: diagramming program values by spatial refinement (orientation, cyclic, group)
pipeline_shape: A tiny set of orthogonal spatial primitives refine a default graph layout, solver-backed.
reusable_for_us: Their cognitively motivated primitive set maps almost 1:1 onto zones/connects/inside.
notes: Predecessor: arXiv 2412.03310

title: TikZilla: DaTikZ-V4 + RL with inverse-graphics image-encoder reward
pipeline_shape: RL for TikZ generation with an image-encoder reward.
key_numbers: Qwen 3B/8B match GPT-5 on image-based eval
reusable_for_us: Small-model drawing tier evidence.

title: VectorGym: four SVG tasks with a human-validated VLM-as-judge
pipeline_shape: Benchmark with validated VLM judge.
reusable_for_us: A validated judge protocol for vector drawings.

title: GeoLoom: text → formal GeoLingua → Monte-Carlo coordinate solver
pipeline_shape: Model names geometry constraints; solver finds coordinates.
reusable_for_us: Another model-names/solver-places instance, for geometry diagrams.

title: TikZero / DeTikZify-v2: image embedding bridges text and TikZ programs
pipeline_shape: Text → TikZ via image-embedding bridge.
key_numbers: DaTikZ-v2 360k
reusable_for_us: Alternative drawing backend (TikZ→SVG) with a released model.

title: Can GPTs Evaluate Graphic Design… (white-space metric)

reusable_for_us: White-space formula for a dead-space sidecar field.

title: CAL-RAG: retrieval + generator/grader/feedback agents for layout
pipeline_shape: Retrieval-augmented multi-agent loop.
reusable_for_us: Low.

title: LGGPT: unified layout generation with a compact box-token encoding
pipeline_shape: 1.5B GPT-2-XL emits box tokens for all layout tasks.

title: OmniSVG (and StarVector, Chat2SVG): text/image → SVG generators
pipeline_shape: Generative SVG models.

pipeline_shape: Plan boxes/relations, then render.

pipeline_shape: LLM writes many imperfect verifier programs in a layout DSL (id/class/position/size/bbox; queries intersects/distance/facing), aggregated by weak learning from ~10 labelled layouts.

pipeline_shape: Lightweight computational scorers + VLM local feedback; 100k perturbed Crello samples each isolating one violation.

title: EduIllustrate: K-12 text+diagram explanations, 8-dimension rubric, sequential anchoring
pipeline_shape: Generate explanation + diagrams per K-12 problem; 'sequential anchoring' for cross-diagram consistency; LLM-judge validated vs 20 expert raters.
verification: 8-dim rubric grounded in multimedia-learning theory; ρ vs experts
key_numbers: ρ ≥ 0.83 on objective dimensions, weak on subjective visual; Gemini 3 Pro 87.8%, Kimi-K2.5 80.8% at $0.12/problem; sequential anchoring +13% visual consistency at −94% cost

title: Azure Speech TTS: WordBoundary + BookmarkReached events (SSML <bookmark>)
pipeline_shape: Synthesis raises WordBoundary (audioOffset in 100-ns units, text offset) per word and BookmarkReached for SSML bookmarks; supported by Azure neural voices incl. hi-IN, not by OpenAI voices.
reusable_for_us: Native per-word timing for Hindi voices with no aligner — manim-voiceover's AzureService already consumes these for bookmarks; the cheapest path to synced entrances.
notes: Q&A threads report zero audioOffset for some voices — verify on the chosen hi-IN voice.

title: ElevenLabs TTS with-timestamps (character-level alignment) + Forced Alignment API
pipeline_shape: /v1/text-to-speech/{voice}/with-timestamps returns character alignment; separate forced-alignment endpoint; multilingual_v2 covers Hindi.
reusable_for_us: Per-character timing for Hindi; code-mixed romanised text is handled as text, so bookmarks can be derived by character offset.
notes: language_code not supported on multilingual_v2.

title: Evaluation of forced alignment of code-mixed speech: the case of Hindi-English
pipeline_shape: Montreal Forced Aligner with acoustic models trained on sentence-level code-mixed Hindi-English data.
verification: mean boundary error vs manual alignment
key_numbers: code-mixed model 4.15 ms mean error vs 38.18 ms (monolingual Hindi) and 37.58 ms (isolated English)
reusable_for_us: The exact aligner result our Hinglish bookmarks need: train/obtain a code-mixed MFA model; ~4 ms error is far inside a 300 ms bookmark tolerance.
notes: Abstract does not state whether romanised or Devanagari text was used — check the full text; model release not stated.

title: Sarvam Bulbul v3 TTS: code-mixed Hinglish handled at model level
pipeline_shape: Single-pass synthesis of Hinglish with number normalisation; 30+ voices; ≤2500 chars/request.
reusable_for_us: Best-fit voice for Hinglish; NO word timestamps found in the TTS docs (STT has timestamps) — pair with MMS/MFA alignment.
notes: This repo already routes primary TTS through Sarvam when keyed.

title: manim-voiceover bookmarks: <bookmark mark='x'/> in narration + tracker.time_until_bookmark()
pipeline_shape: Word boundaries come from the TTS service (Azure) or from Whisper transcription (transcription_model='base'); animations wait until the bookmark's time.
reusable_for_us: Already a dependency; the transpiler imports remove_bookmarks and never emits bookmarks — the sync mechanism is one IR field away.

title: MMS forced aligner (torchaudio MMS_FA, uroman romanisation, 1000+ languages) + ctc-forced-aligner
pipeline_shape: CTC emissions + Viterbi over ROMANISED text (uroman) — text must be romanised, which is what our Hinglish already is.

title: Continuous Temporal Contiguity Narration–Animation for Learning in VR
pipeline_shape: 12-minute system-paced multimedia lesson with sentence blocks composed to match video images per the temporal contiguity principle.
reusable_for_us: Recent empirical support that narration must be timed to the image — the pedagogical case for bookmarks.

title: AI4Bharat IndicConformer (22 languages, CTC-RNNT) / IndicVoices

title: HiACC: Hinglish adult & children code-switched speech corpus
pipeline_shape: Corpus.
reusable_for_us: Evaluation data for a Hinglish aligner (children's speech included — relevant to grade bands).

title: Indic Parler-TTS / Rasmalai (AI4Bharat) + open Hinglish TTS on IndicF5
pipeline_shape: Open TTS for 21–23 Indian languages (1,806 h; Rasmalai 13k h with descriptions); Hinglish TTS = IndicF5 + duration patch + IndicXlit script normalisation.

title: Tradition or Innovation: modern ASR methods vs MFA for forced alignment
pipeline_shape: Compares MFA, MMS, WhisperX.

reusable_for_us: Pick MFA when a model exists; MMS as fallback.
notes: Also: Multilingual word-level alignment with SSL + learned DP (2606.10675); BFA real-time multilingual TTS alignment (2509.23147).

title: WhisperX: word-level timestamps via wav2vec2 forced alignment (+ 'Whisper Has an Internal Word Aligner')

title: Speech-Synchronized Whiteboard Generation via VLM-Driven Structured Drawing Representations
pipeline_shape: VLM emits a structured drawing representation whose strokes are scheduled against speech.
reusable_for_us: A direct precedent for scheduling drawing strokes to narration words — the whiteboard-style sync our sustain filler approximates.
notes: Read in full before v1.3.

title: Mayer — Multimedia Learning: segmenting, temporal contiguity, signaling principles
pipeline_shape: Canonical principles: learner-paced segments; words and pictures presented simultaneously; cues that highlight organisation.
reusable_for_us: The source for pacing/sync rules and for scorecard dimensions (coherence, signaling, segmenting, modality).
notes: Guo, Kim & Rubin (L@S 2014) remains the engagement-vs-length reference (~6 min).

title: InflationAgent: per-call price understates agentic cost >2× because of retries; fresh escalation
pipeline_shape: Measures cost inflation from retries; escalates with a fresh context instead of forwarding failed chains.
key_numbers: 4.25× inflation for 7B; forwarding failed chains costs up to −34.8 pts; 94.7% vs FrugalGPT 91.0% at −31% tokens
reusable_for_us: Meter retries into per-stage cost and escalate fresh — consistent with DDI's fresh-start finding.

title: Verify, Repair, Repeat, or Stop? (VRR-Stop / VRR-Guard)
pipeline_shape: Four-parameter noise model (verifier false-accept/false-reject, repairer correct/degrade); belief filter; commit when marginal gain ≤ 0; VRR-Guard needs a verification margin before replacing the incumbent.
key_numbers: +60.6 pts final true validity vs fixed 5 rounds (GSM8K stress); 0.72 repair rounds on average
reusable_for_us: The stopping theory we lack: our accept-only-if-violations-fall is VRR-Guard with margin 1; estimate the probe's FA/FR from planted faults and the policy follows.

title: VIABLE: planted-fault evaluation of judges (12-mode failure taxonomy, 300K judgments)
pipeline_shape: Inject known failures into outputs; measure judge diagnostic accuracy, impartiality, stability.
key_numbers: best judge (GPT-5.4) 52.6% single-fault diagnostic accuracy; 94.2% self-preference
reusable_for_us: Seed known layout faults into our own renders and measure the vision reviewer's recall/FPR before switching it back on.

title: Debugging Decay Index (DDI): exponential decay of repair success per attempt
pipeline_shape: Fit decay to per-attempt repair success; strategic fresh start at the inflection.
key_numbers: models lose 60–80% of debugging capability within 2–3 attempts
reusable_for_us: Round 3+ should be a fresh regeneration, not another repair of the same script.

title: MLLM as a UI Judge (Adobe Research)
pipeline_shape: 30 UIs, 500 crowd raters, 9,296 responses vs GPT-4o/Claude/Llama-3.2-V.
verification: Pearson vs crowd; pairwise preference accuracy
key_numbers: Pearson 0.69–0.73; pairwise accuracy ~60% overall, 93% when the gap is large
reusable_for_us: A VLM can rank clearly different frames, not near-ties — gate only on large deltas.

title: MiniCheck / LLM-AggreFact: cheap sentence-vs-chunk grounding verifier
pipeline_shape: 770M Flan-T5 (or Bespoke-MiniCheck-7B) entailment of each sentence against source chunks.
key_numbers: GPT-4-level accuracy at ~1/400 cost
reusable_for_us: Run each narration sentence against the ResearchPack chunks; cheap enough per beat.
notes: Still the default cheap verifier in 2026.

title: Blind Resampling Outperforms Self-Repair in Small Code Models
pipeline_shape: Below 7B, showing the failed attempt causes anchoring.
key_numbers: 33–68% near-identical retries vs 2–14% blind; error feedback adds nothing over placebo (<7B)
reusable_for_us: If the repair tier uses a small/cheap model, don't show it the old script.

title: Evaluating and Guarding Citation Faithfulness in Agentic Scientific Synthesis (conformal guard)
pipeline_shape: Gold-anchored protocol (BM25 re-attribution) to validate verifiers; split-conformal guard with a finite-sample bound.
key_numbers: unsupported rate 3–18% by verifier strictness; negative-specific agreement between verifiers 0.27–0.30; guard 0.94 recall on supported
reusable_for_us: Verifiers disagree most on UNSUPPORTED claims — calibrate with conformal thresholds, not a single judge.

title: ExpeRepair: episodic + semantic repair memories composed into prompts
pipeline_shape: Demonstrations + reflective insights retrieved into the repair prompt.
key_numbers: 60.3% SWE-bench Lite / 74.6% Verified
reusable_for_us: Memory design for the error→repair store (off today): demonstrations + insights, verified-only.
notes: code public

title: From Faulty Memories to Corrected Actions: dependency-guided rollback for persistent agent memory
pipeline_shape: Persistent memory makes errors durable; proposes rollback.
reusable_for_us: Store only verified error→fix pairs and keep a rollback path — the safety half of repair memory.

title: How Many Tries Does It Take? self-repair across 7 models, error-type breakdown
pipeline_shape: ≤5 rounds on HumanEval/MBPP with error-type breakdown.
key_numbers: two rounds capture 76–95% of achievable gain; logic errors repair at ~45% vs much higher for syntax/name errors; self-repair saves 11–54% tokens vs resampling
reusable_for_us: Classify the violation type — geometric 'logic' faults repair far less reliably than NameErrors (matches _classify_render_failure).

title: Reliability without Validity: 21 judges × 3 benchmarks, 541K judgments
pipeline_shape: Agreement, test-retest, bias audits across judges.
key_numbers: κ 33–41 pts below exact-match accuracy; rankings shift up to 14 places; >0.95 test-retest yet >0.10 position bias
reusable_for_us: Report κ and bias for any judge we adopt, never raw agreement (their Minimum Viable Validation Protocol).

title: FaithLens: factuality vs faithfulness split
pipeline_shape: Separates faithful-to-source from factually-true.
reusable_for_us: Closest framing to 'pedagogical invention vs hallucination' — the fact/analogy/worked-example tagger is still unclaimed.
notes: No work found that formally separates pedagogical invention from hallucination.

title: Teach2Eval: score a teacher model by a weak student's post-teaching gain
pipeline_shape: Student-model MCQ gain as the metric (text-only).
verification: aligns with Arena rankings across 26 LLMs
reusable_for_us: Same idea as TeachQuiz — a learning-gain proxy without humans.

title: Elmes*: auto-constructed fine-grained rubrics for 330 educational scenarios
pipeline_shape: Rubric auto-construction; judges show low variance but self-preference bias.
key_numbers: >1,000 indicators
reusable_for_us: Rubric construction method for scene-level pedagogy checks.

title: UCCI: isotonic-calibrated error probability → cascade threshold
pipeline_shape: Calibrated confidence decides escalation.
reusable_for_us: Calibrated escalation for the model chains.
notes: See also 'Is Escalation Worth It?' 2605.06350.

title: Textual-to-Visual Self-Verification for slide generation
pipeline_shape: Render layout to an image before the LLM reviews it; reviewer/refiner loop.
reusable_for_us: Render-before-review is what Studio's blueprint should become.
notes: No calibration numbers.

title: FrugalGPT (cascades) and RouteLLM (LMSYS) — cost-aware routing
pipeline_shape: Quality-thresholded cascades / learned routers.
key_numbers: FrugalGPT up to 98% cost cut at GPT-4 parity; RouteLLM ~85% cost cut at 95% GPT-4 quality (MT-Bench)
reusable_for_us: Background for tiered routing in model_routing.py.

title: AeSlides: verifiable geometric rewards (aspect, whitespace, collision, balance) instead of VLM reflection
pipeline_shape: GRPO with deterministic geometric rewards for slide generation.
key_numbers: collisions −43%, whitespace −44%, human score 3.31→3.56 on 5K prompts; beats reflection and Claude Sonnet 4.5
reusable_for_us: Strong evidence that deterministic geometric checks beat VLM critics for layout — extend the probe (whitespace, balance) before re-enabling the VLM.

title: Omni-Judge: 9-dimension omni-LLM judge for audio+video+text
pipeline_shape: Multimodal judge over audio/video/text.
key_numbers: human τ only 0.29 (audio-text alignment) and 0.14 (sync)
reusable_for_us: Narration–visual sync is NOT reliably judged automatically yet — measure it deterministically (bookmark-hit) instead.

title: LLM vs expert coding of lesson plans (explicit components reliable, high-inference constructs not)
pipeline_shape: 32 lesson plans, o1 vs expert coding, mixed methods.
key_numbers: reliable on explicit components ('objective stated', 'terms defined'); unreliable on coherence/rationale
reusable_for_us: Validates the lint shape: surface checks yes, 'is this good teaching' no.

title: SciEval: 273 lesson materials, 3,549 expert evaluations, 13 EQuIP-rubric criteria
pipeline_shape: LLMs predict rubric score + evidence span.
key_numbers: off-the-shelf models underperform; fine-tuned Qwen3 +11%
reusable_for_us: EQuIP criteria as a lint checklist; 'cite the evidence span' makes a lint auditable.

title: LearnLM: Improving Gemini for Learning (pedagogical instruction following, 25-item rubric)
pipeline_shape: Scenario-guided side-by-side conversations rated by ≥3 educators per turn on a 25-item pedagogy rubric (7-point Likert).
key_numbers: expert preference +31% vs GPT-4o, +11% vs Claude 3.5 Sonnet, +13% vs Gemini 1.5 Pro
reusable_for_us: The rubric attribute list (active learning, cognitive load, adaptivity…) only; evals are dialogue-shaped, not video.
notes: May-2025 update: arXiv 2505.24477; AI-augmented textbook: 2509.13348 (students +5.5 pp on novel problems with LearnLM tutoring).

title: EntityBench: entity-consistent long-range multi-shot video generation (+ EntityMem)
pipeline_shape: Per-shot entity schedules; memory bank of verified per-entity references.
key_numbers: 140 episodes, 2,491 shots
reusable_for_us: A per-scene entity schedule is the formalisation of 'the anchor appears in every scene' — and a metric for it.
notes: Also NarrLV (2507.11245) narrative-centric long-video eval.

title: Shiksha Copilot: teacher-AI collaboration for curriculum-aligned lesson plans in Karnataka (English + Kannada)
pipeline_shape: RAG over state curriculum → LLM draft → human curators review → teachers adapt; deployed Dec 2024–Mar 2025 for grades 5–10.
reusable_for_us: The Indian-curriculum grounding + curator-in-the-loop workflow; directly comparable audience (state-board teachers).

title: DOC: Improving Long Story Coherence with Detailed Outline Control
pipeline_shape: Hierarchical detailed outline conditioned throughout generation; controller keeps sections on-outline.
key_numbers: plot coherence +22.5%, outline relevance +28.2%, interestingness +20.7% (absolute)
reusable_for_us: The chapter outline + per-chapter conditioning pattern for 10–15 min videos.

title: NotebookLM Video Overviews (narrated slides; Explainer + Brief formats; Nano Banana visuals; Cinematic)
pipeline_shape: Pulls central concepts from sources, orders them, generates slides with visuals/quotes/numbers from the documents; narration over slides.
reusable_for_us: The product shape the user asked for; no published planning or verification details — our screen plan is the explicit version.
notes: Help page: support.google.com/notebooklm/answer/16454555

title: Student Perceptions and Preferences Regarding AI-Generated Instructional Videos in Computing Education (Knowlify)
pipeline_shape: Students watched three AI-generated explainer videos made with Knowlify.
key_numbers: 170 students, two US institutions; nearly half could not tell the videos were AI-generated; preference for simple, supplemental, visual use cases
reusable_for_us: Audience evidence: acceptance is high for supplemental explainers, concern is accuracy — fidelity checks matter more than polish.
notes: No learning outcome measured. Rapid review of AI instructional videos: Frontiers 10.3389/fcomp.2025.1721093.

title: IndiMathQA: 598 NCERT grade 10–12 math problems, Hindi + English reasoning
pipeline_shape: Curriculum-learning fine-tuning on NCERT problems.
key_numbers: 598 problems, 14 domains
reusable_for_us: An NCERT-aligned test set for fidelity checks on math topics.
notes: Also: LLMs in rural Indian K-12 (2505.03163).

title: LearnLM May-2025 report + Towards an AI-Augmented Textbook (Oct 2025)
pipeline_shape: Pedagogical instruction following; textbook transformations with content-integrity constraints and pedagogical evaluation.
key_numbers: students with LearnLM tutoring +5.5 pp more likely to solve novel problems vs human tutors alone
reusable_for_us: 'Transform without changing content' evaluation is the template for checking chapter rewrites keep the source.

title: MovieAgent: automated movie generation via multi-agent CoT planning (director/screenwriter/storyboard artist)
pipeline_shape: Hierarchical CoT structures scenes, camera settings, cinematography from a script + character bank.
reusable_for_us: Shot-list hierarchy as an explicit artifact; no plan-coverage metric.
notes: FilmAgent (2501.12909) is the 3D-virtual-space sibling.

title: PresentAgent: document → outline → template retrieval → slides + narration notes → TTS → video
pipeline_shape: Outline first, then per-slide VLM generation, then narration synthesis.
reusable_for_us: Outline→slides is the chapter→screens shape.

title: Script2Screen: supporting dialogue scriptwriting with interactive audiovisual generation
pipeline_shape: Writer edits script; system regenerates the audiovisual preview incrementally.
reusable_for_us: Incremental per-scene regeneration UX for Studio.

title: Generating Long-form Story Using Dynamic Hierarchical Outlining with Memory-Enhancement
pipeline_shape: Dynamic outline + temporal knowledge-graph memory of generated content.
reusable_for_us: The running-summary thread as a structured memory rather than prose.
notes: Also StoryWriter (CIKM 2025, doi 10.1145/3746252.3761616); character-grounded multi-agent story gen (2607.00918).

title: SketchDynamics: free-form sketch storyboards interpreted by a VLM agent into animation
pipeline_shape: Sketch storyboard → VLM intent → animation.
reusable_for_us: A sketch as an input to the screen plan.
notes: Also VideoDiff (CHI 2025), LAVE (2402.10294) for LLM-assisted video editing.

title: Generative Lecture: making lecture videos interactive with LLMs and AI-clone instructors
pipeline_shape: Lecture summary + slide content + student question → LLM answer → HeyGen avatar.
reusable_for_us: Low.
notes: Also ALIVE (2512.20858), Talking Slide Avatars (2604.23703), AI-powered video lectures in HE (2511.20660).

title: LessonPlanLM: knowledge-enhanced automatic lesson plan generation
pipeline_shape: LLM + lesson-plan knowledge base.
reusable_for_us: Knowledge-base-conditioned planning for the PARTS stage.

title: TeachLM: post-training LLMs for education using authentic learning data
pipeline_shape: Post-training on real tutoring data.
reusable_for_us: Low.

title: BEA 2025 Shared Task: Pedagogical Ability Assessment of AI-powered Tutors
pipeline_shape: Shared task on assessing tutor responses pedagogically.
reusable_for_us: Pedagogy-assessment dimensions that transfer to narration.
